verified.project_tests_run: At the pinned commit in the image build: `go test ./config/`, `go test ./coordinator/services/ -run '^(TestEnsureBootstrapAdminUser|TestResetOrInsertAdminPassword)'`, `go test ./passwordhash/` — all pass. The rest of coordinator/services has a pre-existing unrelated failure (mapping seed count 9 vs 10) at the pinned commit and is not used. The affected-area project tests are not part of grading because the published fix rewrites their expectations (they assert the fixed hash and the old service signature); the hidden functional group asserts the same coupled behaviour through the public entry points instead.

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected object is the administrator account's own stored credential; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the local provider has one role and one direction; the several credential-placement routes are separate tests, not one toggle
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: every route writes or creates a credential; sign-in is only the outcome oracle, there is no read-only counterpart to leave unguarded
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the blank/whitespace no-credential shape is covered by both a security and a functional test; a guard that mishandles it stores a blank value, which fails the functional group rather than leaving an exploitable credential
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: when the settings store cannot be opened the coordinator refuses to start; there is no fail-open path that would authenticate without a stored credential
